privacy.intro.message: Liúhèn is a local-first app. This page explains, in plain words, where your data goes.

privacy.local.body.message: All records are stored as JSON in the app's local directory on your phone. No account system, no cloud sync, no telemetry. Uninstalling removes the data with the app — nothing is sent to any server.

privacy.ai.body.message: By default, Liúhèn makes no network requests (except update checks). Requests to your own OpenAI-compatible endpoint only happen when you select evidence in the Studio and explicitly ask for generation.

privacy.outbound.body.message: Before every real request, the app shows a disclosure sheet: who it goes to and which fields it includes. Nothing is sent until you confirm, and only the minimal fields you selected are included. Your API key lives in system-isolated storage (Android Keystore + EncryptedSharedPreferences) and is never echoed in the UI.

privacy.logs.title.message: Logs: three things we never record

privacy.logs.body.message: Logs never contain your API key, the body of your records, or the full text of prompts.

privacy.update.body.message: The app contacts a version manifest (latest.json) to check for updates: manually from the About page, or automatically at launch (can be disabled). This is the only default network behavior — it fetches a version number and download URL, and never uploads local data.

feedback.intro.message: Liúhèn is early-stage software — every piece of feedback goes straight into the development queue.

feedback.issues.body.message: File them on GitHub Issues: github.com/greatleo31/daily-asking/issues. Please search for existing issues first; crash reports should include reproduction steps.

feedback.discussion.body.message: Longer discussions and usage stories are welcome in the repository's Discussions area. We reply to every post.

feedback.security.body.message: Please do not open public issues for security vulnerabilities. See SECURITY.md in the repository for the private contact channel; we will credit you after confirmation.

feedback.contribute.body.message: Liúhèn is MIT-licensed and PRs are welcome. Read CONTRIBUTING.md first for branch conventions and the quality gates (analyze / test all green).

roadmap.intro.message: A transparent view of what's next. This is not a promise list — progress is tracked by the actual commits in the repository.

roadmap.done.body.message: Evidence notes & the local follow-up engine · Growth map (search / filters / completeness) · Studio (resume bullets / weekly reports / interview cards) · BYOK optional AI with outbound disclosure · Four-stage growth companion · In-app update mechanism.

roadmap.doing.body.message: Product website & docs · Polishing the companion experience (early design of quotes and monthly chapters).

roadmap.ideas.body.message: Companion 'maturity without graduation': monthly chapters and a small collectible each month · Richer export formats (Markdown / PDF sharing) · More artifact templates.

roadmap.nongoals.body.message: Accounts · Cloud sync · Telemetry · Subscriptions and ads. These are not unscheduled — they are principles.
